data: What is the approximate BLEU score for Ke=0 when the size of the AMR graph is 11-20?

The question asks for the approximate BLEU score for Ke=0 when the size of the AMR graph is 11-20. From the left graph, we can see that the blue line represents Ke=0, and the x-axis shows the size of the AMR graph in intervals. The interval "11-20" corresponds to the second bar group on the x-axis. Observing the blue line at this interval, the approximate BLEU score is around 29.
